5428:     function getCostSum(selector){
5429:       return [...document.querySelectorAll(selector)].reduce((acc, el) => acc + Number(el.value || 0), 0);
5430:     }
5431: 
5432:     function getFormationCalc(){
5433:       const fixed = getCostSum('[data-cost]');
5434:       const variable = getCostSum('[data-var]');
5435:       const alunos = Math.max(1, n('alunos'));
5436:       const pagantes = Math.max(1, n('pagantes'));
5437:       const inad = Math.min(80, Math.max(0, n('inadimplencia'))) / 100;
5438:       const reserva = Math.max(0, n('reserva')) / 100;
5439:       const margem = Math.max(0, n('margem')) / 100;
5440:       const arredondar = Number(document.getElementById('arredondar').value || 1);
5441: 
5442:       const custoFixoAluno = fixed / pagantes;
5443:       const custoTotalAluno = custoFixoAluno + variable;
5444:       const minima = roundTo(custoTotalAluno, arredondar);
5445:       const seguraBase = custoTotalAluno / Math.max(.01, (1 - inad));
5446:       const segura = roundTo(seguraBase * (1 + reserva), arredondar);
5447:       const ideal = roundTo(segura * (1 + margem), arredondar);
5448: 
5449:       const receitaMinima = minima * pagantes;
5450:       const receitaSegura = segura * pagantes;
5451:       const receitaIdeal = ideal * pagantes;
5452:       const custoTotalEscola = fixed + (variable * alunos);
5453:       const lucroIdeal = receitaIdeal - custoTotalEscola;

6354:     function estimateScenario(base, occupancyShift, inadShift){
6355:       const adjustedPayers = Math.max(1, Math.round(base.totalPayers * (1 + occupancyShift)));
6356:       const inadFactor = Math.max(.01, 1 - Math.max(0, base.form.inad + inadShift));
6357:       const revenue = base.avgTicketCurrent * adjustedPayers * inadFactor;
6358:       return revenue - base.totalCost;
6359:     }

5428:     function getCostSum(selector){
5429:       return [...document.querySelectorAll(selector)].reduce((acc, el) => acc + Number(el.value || 0), 0);
5430:     }
5431: 
5432:     function getFormationCalc(){
5433:       const fixed = getCostSum('[data-cost]');
5434:       const variable = getCostSum('[data-var]');
5435:       const alunos = Math.max(1, n('alunos'));
5436:       const pagantes = Math.max(1, n('pagantes'));
5437:       const inad = Math.min(80, Math.max(0, n('inadimplencia'))) / 100;
5438:       const reserva = Math.max(0, n('reserva')) / 100;
5439:       const margem = Math.max(0, n('margem')) / 100;
5440:       const arredondar = Number(document.getElementById('arredondar').value || 1);
5441: 
5442:       const custoFixoAluno = fixed / pagantes;
5443:       const custoTotalAluno = custoFixoAluno + variable;
5444:       const minima = roundTo(custoTotalAluno, arredondar);
5445:       const seguraBase = custoTotalAluno / Math.max(.01, (1 - inad));
5446:       const segura = roundTo(seguraBase * (1 + reserva), arredondar);
5447:       const ideal = roundTo(segura * (1 + margem), arredondar);
5448: 
5449:       const receitaMinima = minima * pagantes;
5450:       const receitaSegura = segura * pagantes;
5451:       const receitaIdeal = ideal * pagantes;

7421:     // Export CSV
7422:     function exportCSV(){
7423:       let rows = [];
7424:       try{ rows = getComparisonData(); }catch(e){ showToast('Configure os dados primeiro!'); return; }
7425:       const ipca = getIPCARate();
7426:       const headers = ['Turma','Idade','Horario','Preco Atual','Recomendado','Diferenca','Diferenca %','Status','Ref IPCA'];
7427:       const lines = [headers.join(';')];
7428:       rows.forEach(r => {
7429:         const ipcaRef = (r.current*(1+ipca)).toFixed(2).replace('.',',');
7430:         lines.push([r.turma,r.idade,r.hour+'h',
7431:           r.current.toFixed(2).replace('.',','),
7432:           r.recommended.toFixed(2).replace('.',','),
7433:           r.diff.toFixed(2).replace('.',','),
7434:           r.diffPercent.toFixed(1).replace('.',',')+'%',
7435:           r.status.label, ipcaRef].join(';'));
7436:       });
7437:       const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF'+lines.join('\n')],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'});
7438:       const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
7439:       const a = document.createElement('a');
7440:       a.href=url; a.download='mensalidades-'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.csv';
7441:       document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
7442:       URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
7443:       showToast('CSV exportado!');
7444:     }

6767:       if(!file) return;
6768:       const reader = new FileReader();

6770:         try{
6771:           const state = JSON.parse(reader.result);

6773:           applyState(state);
6774:           if(Array.isArray(state.history)) localStorage.setItem('novaSabaraHistorico_v2', JSON.stringify(state.history));

6776:           if(typeof renderHistory==='function') renderHistory();
6777:           showToast('Backup importado!');
6778:         }catch(e){
6779:           alert('Não foi possível importar este backup. Verifique se o arquivo é JSON válido.');
6780:         }
6781:       };
6782:       reader.readAsText(file);
6783:     }
